title: Samhain Halloween Event Poster
coreRelationships: The large, distressed 'SAMHAIN' text is the primary title, dominating the upper left.
A menacing, horned skeleton figure occupies the right half, its form intertwined and reaching towards the center.
Event details are stacked vertically on the left, using varied, hand-drawn fonts.
The background is a solid, textured black, providing stark contrast to the white text and illustration.
Smaller, supporting text elements are scattered around the main content, like 'ALL AGES!' and 'WPTS PLAN 9'.
reuseFormula: Create a black background with a subtle grunge texture. Place a large, distressed, hand-drawn title in white at the top left. Below it, stack event details in various hand-drawn, distressed white fonts. On the right side, illustrate a menacing, horned skeletal or monstrous figure in white, ensuring its form is dynamic and visually balances the text. Add small, supporting white text elements as needed, maintaining a high-contrast, monochromatic aesthetic.
